---
title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---



```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)
library(tidyverse)
library(easystats)
library(patchwork)
source("utils_for_group_project.R")
```


```{r}
df_day %>% data_codebook()
```

```{r}
cat_EDA(df_day, cat_col = c(
  "season", "holiday", "workingday", "weathersit",
  "yr", "mnth", "weekday"
))
```


```{r}
Training %>%
  correlation::correlation() %>%
  summary() %>%
  plot() +
  theme_ev()
```

```{r}
Training %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cnt)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  Training %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cnt)) +
  geom_density(colour = "red")
```

```{r}
cat_col[!cat_col %in% c("yr", "mnth", "weekday")] %>%
  map(~ ggplot(Training, aes(x = .data[[.x]], y = cnt)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(x = .x)) %>%
  wrap_plots(ncol = 2)
```

```{r}
num_col %>%
  map(~ ggplot(Training, aes(y = .data[[.x]], x = cnt)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
    labs(x = .x)) %>%
  wrap_plots(ncol = 2)
```
